body: server/weather: Engine{phase,phaseEnds,rng} with 4 phases (Clear/Overcast/Rain/Storm), duration ranges 1-12min, Modifiers{MobDamageBonus,BSTTameBonus}. ForcePhase for GM/testing. 12 tests. apps2/mud: weatherEngine replaces ad-hoc random system. Phase change broadcast to all players with modifier summary. 'weather' command shows current phase+modifiers. BST tame applies Storm +10% bonus. Prompt shows weather phase when non-Clear.
title: S105-03+04: Weather engine — Phase/Engine/Mods + MUD wiring (broadcast, BST bonus, prompt)
